_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the ReSkate dedicated server (Linux port in Rust). https://github.com/wildesPepega/ReSkate-Linux-Server
name: ReSkate
author: 68642699+wildesPepega@users.noreply.github.com
description: ReSkate dedicated server for skate. (Linux build). Players find it in the in-game server browser (Multiplayer > Servers) or join with its code. Needs a primary UDP allocation (game port) and a second one for the query port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ReSkate dedicated server: SteamCMD for Steam's steamclient.so, then the server itself.
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates tar lib32gcc-s1

mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz
rm steamcmd.tar.gz
export HOME=/mnt/server
./steamcmd.sh +quit || true

# The server signs in to Steam through steamclient.so: ~/.steam/sdk64 and next to the server.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -f linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
cp -f linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/steamclient.so

cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the server from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    curl -sSL -o reskate.tar.gz "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    tar -xzf reskate.tar.gz --strip-components=1
    rm reskate.tar.gz
else
    echo "No DOWNLOAD_URL: upload the contents of ReSkateServer-linux-x64.tar.gz to the server's folder."
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/ReSkateServer 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Install finished."

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: UDP port for Steam server queries (ping in the server browser). Add it as a second allocation; it must differ from the game port.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: URL of ReSkateServer-linux-x64.tar.gz. Defaults to the latest release; reinstall the server to update. Leave empty and upload the files yourself instead.
